feeds.title: Newport Life Magazine » Art & Design
feeds.description: A new wave of Newport Life Magazine. We invite you to experience the life of Newport County in our print publication. Stay in tune with the Island life, style, history, culture and art that encapsulates the experience of Newport, Rhode Island. Stay up to date with the latest art exhibitions and events in Newport County here.

feeds.title: Boston.com » Culture
feeds.description: Stay up to date with Boston.com coverage of Culture. Boston.com is your source for all the latest news coverage from Boston including weather, politics, sports and more!

feeds.title: Below the Surface Blog
feeds.description: New England Wax is an organization of professional artists based in the New England states of the United States. All N.E.W. artists utilize the medium of encaustic (the use of beeswax mixed with tree resin and/or pigments) in their art. Members meet regularly to organize group exhibitions and to share their knowledge with each other. This blog is a collaboration by N.E.W. members about the world of art and the influence it has on their work.

feeds.title: ArtsBoston Blog
feeds.description: ArtsBoston is a leading force behind Greater Boston's arts and culture sector. ArtsBoston creates powerful relationships between arts organizations, the public, and every sector of civic life to build an arts sector that represents the true character and diversity of our city. With our partners, we are expanding audiences, strengthening the community, and advocating for the immense value that the arts, culture, and creativity bring to our sector.

feeds.title: Northshore Magazine » Arts + Culture
feeds.description: For 20 years, Northshore magazine has offered sophisticated service journalism coupled with stunning photography. We report on desirable towns and neighborhoods, places to hike and bike along the coast, which doctors are first-rate, and which restaurants, shops, spas, salons, and services are the Best of the North Shore. Check out what's happening in arts and culture, gallery viewing, events and more!

feeds.title: Chowdaheadz Blog
feeds.description: New England & Boston Lifestyle Blog About Culture, History, To Do, Food, Fun, Shopping & More. Chowaheadz has been around for 18+ years creating fun for the people of New England & Beyond. We are known for our t-shirts and other novelty items around the lifestyle of our great community.

feeds.title: Mass Cultural Council Blog
feeds.description: Our blog chronicles the Power of Culture at work across the Commonwealth. The Mass Cultural Council is a state agency that promotes excellence, inclusion, education, and diversity in the arts, humanities, and sciences to foster a rich cultural life for all Massachusetts residents and contribute to the vitality of our communities and economy.

feeds.title: New England With Love
feeds.description: On New England With Love, you'll find content about all six fabulous New England states. There will be articles about outdoor adventures to be had in each state, such as hiking, camping, skiing, and much more. We'll feature coastal activities too, from whale watching to sailing and more. All that you know and love about New England you will find here.

feeds.title: Art New England
feeds.description: Art New England is your one-stop shop for diving into the vibrant art scene of the Northeast. As the region's premier art and culture magazine, it brings you in-depth articles on the latest exhibitions, insightful reviews by leading critics, and profiles of the talented artists shaping New England's creative landscape.

feeds.title: Vermont Explored Blog
feeds.description: Vermont Explored is dedicated to providing Vermont travel advice for the adventurous soul. We're here to help you find Vermont's most beautiful spots and unique attractions, along with the best places to eat, drink, and sleep in Vermont. We can help you plan the perfect Vermont road trip, escape somewhere fun for the day, or adventure on a trail, river, or lake.

feeds.title: Artscope Magazine
feeds.description: Now in its 17th year, Artscope offers audiences timely art reviews. Our goal is to provide an understanding of the process, approach and inspiration of local as well as international artists exhibiting throughout the Northeast and beyond. Artscope covers artists, galleries and museums, encouraging its readers to understand the work exhibited and to actively participate in the region's arts community.

feeds.title: Klementovich Art Blog
feeds.description: Rebecca's work unites Abstract painting with Semi Landscapes. She uses a unique colorful palette to express nature. Dropping the horizon line makes a landscape abstract. Graduating from the Fashion Institute of Technology NYC, she specialized in fashion illustration. Check out her arts, events, news and more in the blog.

feeds.title: The Maine Mag » Culture
feeds.description: We share stories about the people of Maine who are using their creativity and ingenuity to propel the state forward. In our 48 Hours features and other travel stories, we highlight places that make Maine so unique, and our coverage of the incredible restaurants here will make you want to explore even more. All of this is accented by beautiful photography that gives you a true sense of place. Keep updated on all the art and culture events and exhibitions in Maine here.

feeds.title: Michael Rose Fine Art Blog
feeds.description: Michael Rose is a multi-talented fine art professional based in Southern New England. Since 2014 he has served as the gallery manager at the historic Providence Art Club, one of the nation's oldest arts organizations. Follow his artistic expressions, personal ramblings and Fine Arts updates here.

feeds.title: Visit New England Blog
feeds.description: Visit New England is a comprehensive travel and tourism website featuring information about attractions, resorts, hotels, inns, weddings and more in the New England region. We also provide diverse content on a wide variety of activities, events, itineraries and travel options. Visit New England was formed in 1995, and originally we ran a website dedicated to tourism in the Mystic region of Connecticut.

feeds.title: Copley Society of Art Blog
feeds.description: The Copley Society of Art, Co|So, is the oldest non-profit arts association in the United States, with a history dating back to 1879. We currently represent over 300 living artist members, ranging in experience from students to nationally-recognized artists and in style from traditional and academic realists to contemporary and abstract painters, photographers, and sculptors. Explore various arts and artists, stories and more!

feeds.title: CommonWealth Beacon » Arts & Culture
feeds.description: Our mission is to stimulate nonpartisan debate, shape policy, and advance a public agenda that supports the growth of the middle class. CommonWealth Magazine's in-depth coverage is a primary news and information source for policymakers, civic leaders & citizens. Discover what's happening in culture and arts, exhibitions, news and more!

feeds.title: Providence Daily Dose
feeds.description: The Providence Daily Dose launched in September of 2007. We are here to bring you the latest news/events/randomness that Providence has offer. We've got our eyes peeled and our ears to the ground to give you, our valued readers, all shit you can handle and more. Remember to get your dose daily, because we've always got something new to blow your mind, or at least get you out of the house.

feeds.title: NewEngland.com
feeds.description: The ultimate online resource for the New England region offering original expert content on New England travel, lifestyle, food, the best events and so much more. Published by Yankee Magazine, the website features the most authoritative and respected voices on the New England lifestyle, and its community of contributing writers, bloggers, photographers and local experts embedded throughout the region.
